Annotators judge which sample is real vs. generated in a Turing test paradigm and rate fidelity
Instructions include specific criteria: quality/clarity (walkie-talkie vs studio sound), melodiousness (rhythm and repetitiveness), harmoniousness (multiple notes in sync)
